Description: SWE-bench Verified evaluates whether a model can produce correct patches for real GitHub issues by editing code in a repository and passing the project’s tests. The “Verified” subset uses tasks that were human-validated to be solvable and includes stricter evaluation to reduce spurious passes.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor), Language Production (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory
L3: Cognitive Flexibility (minor)

Description: SWE-bench Multilingual extends SWE-bench style bug-fixing to multiple programming languages, testing whether models can localize defects and implement patches beyond Python. It stresses cross-language transfer, tooling/test discipline, and robustness to differing ecosystems and idioms.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor), Language Production (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory
L3: Cognitive Flexibility

Description: SWE-bench Pro is a harder, more contamination-resistant software engineering benchmark with larger and more diverse tasks (including multiple languages) intended to better reflect industrial patching. Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory
L3: Cognitive Flexibility, Inhibitory Control (minor)
